{{Top}}
The '''hanno speeder''' was an earlier form of the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], which was used mainly as a racing vehicle. It was a predecessor to podracing with many natives of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] using it to take part in a scaled down [[Boonta Eve Classic]].
